title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section V – Court of Auditors
part_text: Welcomes the Court’s Special report 11/2025: Transparency of Union funding granted to NGOs; notes with concern the problems identified therein, including shortcomings in transparency, classification and oversight; underlines the need for the Court to continue and strengthen its monitoring and reporting on these issues to ensure full compliance with financial rules, transparency requirements and the Union’s fundamental values;
